title: William Herschel discovers Uranus
summary: From his garden in Bath, William Herschel observed an object he first took for a comet. It proved to be a new planet, later named Uranus.
reason: Herschel was systematically surveying the sky with telescopes he built himself.
significance: It was the first planet discovered with a telescope and doubled the known size of the Solar System.
place: New King Street, Bath, United Kingdom
